# Minimal FetchContent cache recipe

Put this before `FetchContent_Declare()` calls:

```cmake
include(FetchContent)

set(FETCHCONTENT_BASE_DIR
    "$ENV{HOME}/.cache/${PROJECT_NAME}/fetchcontent"
    CACHE PATH
    "Shared FetchContent cache")

set(FETCHCONTENT_UPDATES_DISCONNECTED ON CACHE BOOL
    "Do not update FetchContent dependencies automatically")
```

Then use `FetchContent` normally:

```cmake
FetchContent_Declare(
  Catch2
  GIT_REPOSITORY https://github.com/catchorg/Catch2.git
  GIT_TAG        v3.7.1
  GIT_SHALLOW    TRUE
)

FetchContent_MakeAvailable(Catch2)
```

Default behavior:

- The dependency is downloaded once if missing.
- Future build directories reuse the same cache.
- CMake does not check Git remotes for updates.
- To force a fresh download, delete:

```text
$HOME/.cache/<project-name>/fetchcontent
```
